source.release_label_clarification: Upstream Cargo.toml declares package version 0.2.0 at this commit; git tags 0.2.0 (b93f3244c2662447315188653bf01e5cf787e279) and 0.3.0 (134b891c94aae9a718a2467cb637bedbec5d0f97) do NOT point at the pinned commit. The pin is the immutable commit SHA.

archive_method: git archive (no nested .git); assets/ excluded from mirror
integrity: SHA256SUMS in this directory covers all 170 mirrored files

mutable_dependency_pins.isolation_rule: original Cargo.lock retained; branch selector patched to immutable rev only inside the harness workspace (tools/prop-amm-harnesses/), never in the mirror

upstream_shipped_binaries.role: Prebuilt SBF program binaries shipped in the upstream repo (cfg/programs/). These are HARNESS-PROVIDED artifacts, not captured deployed mainnet bytes, unless byte-equal to a captured deployed program.
upstream_shipped_binaries.note: magnus-router-spoof-*.so have no mainnet existence under any program ID. Using them is permitted ONLY inside the local LiteSVM harness.

upstream_shipped_accounts.role: cfg/accounts/*.json are static upstream-captured account snapshots (README Figure-1 slot 401101387, 2026-03-04). They are upstream evidence, not our live capture.
